title: Caption pop word
description: Use for punchy short-form captions that show one big word at a time, popping in as it is spoken. The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
props: {captions: Caption[]; color?: string; accentColor?: string /*'#ff4d6d'*/; fontSize?: number; uppercase?: boolean /*true*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Anton, sans-serif'*/}
